concerns.text: FR-001 requires retrieving data from Materials Project and AFLOWlib 'ensuring all available valid entries are collected'. The plan's 'Data Availability & Feasibility Note' explicitly states the only verified URL is an NLP dataset and the pipeline will 'fail gracefully' or 'halt' if a valid metallic glass dataset is not provided. The plan does not describe a mechanism to satisfy the 'all available' collection requirement from the specified APIs, effectively leaving FR-001 unbacked by a viable implementation path in the current plan.

SC-001 requires measuring predictive accuracy (R²) against a baseline of 'linear weighted average of elemental CTEs'. The plan mentions training 'Linear Regression' and 'Random Forest' models but does not explicitly describe the implementation of the specific 'linear weighted average of elemental CTEs' baseline model required for this comparison. Without this specific baseline implementation, SC-001 cannot be measured.

SC-003 requires measuring feature importance rankings against correlation coefficients on a 'distinct held-out validation set'. The plan describes a 5-fold CV and a train/test split but does not explicitly define or plan for a third 'distinct held-out validation set' separate from the test set used for final evaluation, creating ambiguity on how to satisfy the 'distinct' constraint of SC-003.
